question: How does Svelte achieve high performance without relying on a Virtual DOM at runtime?
options: It compiles components at build time into targeted vanilla JavaScript that surgically updates the DOM
It runs a lightweight WebAssembly reconciliation engine in a Web Worker
It intercepts DOM mutations using native MutationObserver
It renders everything directly into an offscreen HTML5 Canvas
explanation: Svelte is a build-time compiler that generates precise code to update the exact DOM nodes when state changes, eliminating virtual DOM diffing overhead.
